primary_clause.controlled_paraphrase: When the 8-ball is pocketed on the break without a foul, the original breaker chooses spot-and-continue or rerack-and-break-again. When a foul also occurs, the original breaker's opponent chooses spot-plus-BehindHeadString ball in hand, rerack with that opponent breaking, or rerack with the original breaker breaking.

dependent_clauses.role: ordinary break-shot foul is a distinct Core H parent when the 8-ball was not pocketed
unintentional no-rack-contact miscue is a two-rerack-only exception and cannot be inferred from generic no-contact facts
defines collision-safe execution when the 8-ball cannot be placed at the nominal foot spot
defines the separate BehindHeadString placement entitlement after the foul-branch spot parent commits

resolved_actor_and_action_semantics.legal_spot_choice: re-spot the 8-ball and let the original breaker continue the same turn
resolved_actor_and_action_semantics.legal_rerack_choice: rerack and set the original breaker to break again
resolved_actor_and_action_semantics.foul_branch_actor: the player opposing the frozen original breaker
resolved_actor_and_action_semantics.foul_spot_choice: re-spot the 8-ball, then grant that opposing actor one BehindHeadString placement entitlement
resolved_actor_and_action_semantics.foul_rerack_self_choice: rerack and set the opposing decision actor as breaker
resolved_actor_and_action_semantics.foul_rerack_opponent_choice: rerack and set the original breaker as breaker

frozen_audit_row.assessment: Core F implements spot-or-rerack authority and Core E commits effects, but the choice is not product exposed.

as_built_parent_routing.trigger: breakShot=true and canonical pocketedBallsInOrder contains ball 8 after ShotFacts validation

rules.eight_on_break.spot_continue.foundation: one verified Core E 8-ball respot using clause 7 fallback

rules.eight_on_break.rerack_original_bre.foundation: one verified Core E official rerack

rules.eight_on_break.spot_ball_in_hand_h.parent_effect: atomically re-spot the 8-ball and grant the parent actor a BehindHeadString entitlement

rules.eight_on_break.rerack_opponent_bre.foundation: one verified Core E official rerack

classification_and_sibling_boundary.ordinary_break_foul_without_eight: route only to WPA-II-06-E Core H
classification_and_sibling_boundary.illegal_break_without_foul_and_without_e: route only to WPA-II-06-C Core H
classification_and_sibling_boundary.unintentional_no_rack_contact_miscue: WPA-II-06-G remains classification-pending and fail-closed with no Core F or Core H offer

authority_integrity_contract.successful_parent_commit: exactly one authority revision, one event, one authority action, and one receipt
authority_integrity_contract.exact_retry: return the original ACK with no duplicate respot, rerack, entitlement, child, revision, event, or action
authority_integrity_contract.conflicting_retry: fail with rules_decision_idempotency_conflict and no mutation
authority_integrity_contract.stale_or_drifted_request: fail closed and preserve the exact parent offer and all authoritative state

transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.precommit: All product, offer, branch, actor, request, revision, hash, physical-state, idempotency, and Core E plan checks complete before the first authoritative mutation.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.legal_spot_commit: Apply exactly one verified 8-ball respot, preserve the original breaker's turn, close the parent, then record one revision/event/action/receipt.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.foul_spot_commit: Apply exactly one verified 8-ball respot, grant BehindHeadString to the opposing actor, atomically stage one Core G child, close the parent, then record one revision/event/action/receipt.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.rerack_commit: Apply exactly one verified official rerack with the action-selected breaker, clear any precommit BIH residue, close all superseded offers, then record one revision/event/action/receipt.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.child_commit: Physical cue-ball placement is a separate exact Core G transaction; preview and rejected child submissions never mutate authority.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.pre_ack_failure: Any failure before a verified parent ACK leaves runtime physics, rack, cue ball, match, all offers, authority hash/revision, events/actions/receipts, ProductShell, UI, and AI gate byte-for-byte unchanged.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.post_ack_refresh_boundary: A committed GameRuntime ACK is never reversed by product code; UI and AI refresh are non-authoritative and recover through deterministic resync.
transaction_and_full_rollback_contract.idempotent_parent_retry: Return the original ACK without recreating any effect.

as_built_product_reachability.existing_narrow_product_spot_parent_seam: submitProductAuthorizedEightOnBreakRespot accepts only the two Core F spot action IDs when actually offered

future_minimal_closure.authority_correction: Defer foul-branch ballInHand and BehindHeadString scope until the accepted spot-plus-BIH parent commit; all precommit and rerack states must expose no BIH entitlement.
preconditions: offer ruleset/capability/flow identify only Core F
offer branch and exact ordered action vector match either the legal or foul contract
offer actor equals the local product player and the branch-defined actor
request binds exact decision/revision/actor/action/idempotency and canonical {} payload
runtime, not product, already classified and froze the branch
precommit authority hash and physical state remain unchanged

forbidden_scope: production source edits in this design-gap task
ball-in-hand entitlement before accepted foul spot parent commit
physical cue placement in the parent transaction
simultaneous Core F and Core H parents
direct product exposure of Core E foundation actions
